findings.evidence: `TauCeti/MeasureTheory/Function/Lp/CompMeasurePreservingEquiv.lean:92` defines `compMeasurePreservingₗᵢEquiv` from precisely `(hf, hg, f ∘ g =ᵐ id)`; its module docstring states the motivation — "`HilbertBasis.mapₗᵢ` and its relatives consume `≃ₗᵢ` rather than `→ₗᵢ`" — and `Inversion.lean:8` imports that module but uses only `compMeasurePreserving_comp_apply_of_ae_id` from it.
findings.fix: Define `invLpₗᵢ : Lp E p μ ≃ₗᵢ[𝕜] Lp E p μ := Lp.compMeasurePreservingₗᵢEquiv 𝕜 (Measure.measurePreserving_inv μ) (Measure.measurePreserving_inv μ) (.of_eq (funext inv_inv))` — the exact triple already passed at lines 71-73 — keep `coeFn_invLpₗᵢ`, `invLpₗᵢ_invLpₗᵢ`, `invLpₗᵢ_eq_zero_iff` (now via `LinearIsometryEquiv`), and add `@[simp] invLpₗᵢ_symm : (invLpₗᵢ 𝕜 (E := E) (p := p) (μ := μ)).symm = invLpₗᵢ 𝕜`. The same upgrade applies to `conjLpₗᵢ` (Conjugation.lean:194), whose inverse is conjugation by `h⁻¹`.
findings.issue: `invLpₗᵢ : Lp E p μ →ₗᵢ[𝕜] Lp E p μ` under-bundles an isometric automorphism: the file proves involutivity (line 70) and then hand-derives injectivity (`invLpₗᵢ_eq_zero_iff`, line 79), but surjectivity and `symm` never reach the public surface, so a consumer cannot feed it to `HilbertBasis.mapₗᵢ`/`LinearIsometryEquiv`-consuming API and must rebuild the equivalence.

summary: The character-basis surface is minimal, pinned by `coe_*` lemmas, and the module move leaves no compatibility artifact. The one API defect is `invLpₗᵢ`, published as a one-sided linear isometry although the file proves it is an involution and already imports (and discharges the hypotheses of) the repo's `≃ₗᵢ` constructor.
